name: stallhunt
description: Evidence-backed Linux performance triage for ChatGPT and Codex

interface.shortDescription: Find what is stalling this Linux host.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose CPU, memory, and I/O contention on the local Linux machine, identify likely victims and suspects, and inspect the evidence and confidence behind each finding.
defaultPrompt: What is constraining useful work on this Linux host?
Run a five-second hunt and explain the evidence.
